precondition.text: Pair first, THEN lock the wallet — the order matters, because the check is whether a locked wallet still serves requests. A locked mobile wallet is not a locked extension: the WalletConnect session lives on the phone, so a locked wallet can still receive requests. If the wallet app drops the session while locked, requests come back as session_dropped (re-pair and retry); a locked wallet that serves or refuses a request is the finding. Switch the wallet to Polygon before locking it — this check can't switch it for you.
